_readme: HOW TO EDIT THIS FILE: see UPDATING.md in this repository. Add new donations at the TOP of a runner's donations list. Keep the double quotes, keep commas BETWEEN entries, and never leave a comma after the last entry in a list.

event.name: Tree of Life Cancer Run
event.generalDonationsNote: E-transfer and offline donations not tied to a specific runner
event.placeholderNote: You're looking at an example team! Real runner profiles are being added — the totals below are sample data.

runners.name: Angus Anderson
runners.bio: Founder of the foundation and two-time cancer survivor. When Angus isn't organizing fundraisers, he's convincing everyone he knows to sign up for one.
runners.whyImRunning: Every obstacle on this course is nothing compared to a chemo chair. I run so no patient has to face the bills alone.

donations.message: For everything you did for our mom.

runners.name: Sarah Mitchell
runners.bio: Oncology nurse, marathoner, and the team's unofficial hype captain. Sarah has seen what a ride to treatment can mean for a patient's week.
runners.whyImRunning: My patients fight harder than this every single day. The least I can do is get muddy for them.

donations.message: Don't tell your mother how dangerous this looks.
We'll stick to the bikes, thanks.

runners.name: Dev Patel
runners.bio: Software developer and first-time mud runner. Dev joined the team after the foundation helped a close friend get to treatment last winter.
runners.whyImRunning: Someone was there for my best friend when it mattered. This is me paying it forward — one wall at a time.

runners.name: Maria Kowalski
runners.bio: Retired teacher, 12-year survivor, and proof that grit doesn't retire. Maria walks 5k every morning and plans to walk over anyone who doubts her.
runners.whyImRunning: Twelve years ago a stranger paid for my parking at the cancer centre for a whole month. I never got to thank them. This is my thank-you.

runners.name: Jordan Lee
runners.bio: Personal trainer and caregiver to his dad through two rounds of treatment. Jordan is the reason the whole team can now do a proper burpee.
runners.whyImRunning: Caregivers fight this disease too — quietly, in waiting rooms and parking lots. I'm running for everyone holding someone else's hand through it.

donations.message: You carried me through the worst of it, son. Watching you take this on for other families makes every hard day feel like it counted for something. Go show that mountain of mud what this family is made of. I'll be at the finish line — with dry towels and more pride than I know what to do with.
